xmldoc.short_description: Attach an image to the AI options for a vision model.

param_input_item.param_description: a struct of AI options, as returned by nelson.ai.options.
a string: the path to an image file on disk.

param_output_item.param_description: the same options with the image appended to its Images field.

description.p: nelson.ai.attachImage reads an image file, encodes it in base64 and appends it to the Images field of the options, so a vision-capable model receives the image together with the prompt passed to nelson.ai.ask.
The Images field is a cell array of base64 strings. Calling nelson.ai.attachImage several times attaches several images.
When the file does not exist or cannot be read, the options are returned unchanged.

example_item.example_item_description: Attach an image and ask a vision model to describe it.
